description: Snohomish County publishes its drainage inventory as an interactive web map and a zip file in Esri geodatabase format, collected by the county's Surface Water Management and Road Maintenance teams, including data from its Drainage Needs Report effort and ongoing work. The geodatabase holds feature classes for catch basins, closed detentions, culverts, enclosed pipes, energy dissipators, facility access, media filter structures, open channels, overflow controls, permeable pavements, ponds, water quality features and cross sections, with a drainage network layer showing where storm water flows; the download also carries the field collection procedures as a PDF and a data dictionary. Coverage: one county in Washington State. Access: free download; the licence is not stated, and a disclaimer limits use to illustration with no warranty. Caveats: field-collected, so condition and completeness vary, and the inventory date was not stated on the page. It supports network flow modelling and stormwater capacity planning, and relates to the Seattle green stormwater infrastructure layer in the catalogue.
